# Sissy Yan Riley
Millbrae District 2 Councilmember
Endorsement
## Elected Officials
Josh Becker, California State Senator
2026 Millbrae Lunar New Year Festival
David Canepa, President of San Mateo County Supervisor
Anders Fung, Councilmember & Former Mayor of Millbrae
For over two years, Councilmember Sissy Riley has worked tirelessly to protect Millbrae’s best interests in public safety, focusing on making record investments on the east side, economic development, job creation, and most importantly – keeping our community united as we move toward a brighter future. Her dedication and passion for our community is clear. Sissy Riley has my vote for Millbrae City Council.”
